description: DESTRUCTIVE. Delete ONE project by id or code (e.g. "5" or "PR-7"). TWO-STEP: call without `confirm` to get a preview of the project that will be deleted; show it and ASK the user; only then call again with `confirm:true`. It removes the project and everything inside it.

confirm.description: Set true only after the user explicitly confirms.

name: project_delete
title: Delete a project (SimplifyQA)
